scenes.narration: Shakespeare said, love sought is good, but given unsought is better.
scenes.image_query: Shakespeare said, love sought is good, but given unsought is better.

scenes.narration: I never understood what that meant until you.
scenes.image_query: I never understood what that meant until you.

scenes.narration: I spent my whole life chasing people, begging to be chosen, exhausting myself just to prove I was worth keeping around.
scenes.image_query: I spent my whole life chasing people, begging to be chosen, exhausting myself just to prove I was worth keeping around.

scenes.narration: But you didn't wait for me to ask.
scenes.image_query: But you didn't wait for me to ask.

scenes.narration: You didn't make me earn my place.
scenes.image_query: You didn't make me earn my place.

scenes.narration: And handed me the kind of love I never thought I'd experience.
scenes.image_query: And handed me the kind of love I never thought I'd experience.
